note: Private family-run campground on both sides of a bend of the Yellow River near Waterville, mostly permanent (seasonal) campers with nightly sites among them. Tube, kayak and canoe rentals with a shuttle, trout fishing, a water slide, a rentable shelter, and five rental units (park model, trailer houses, a fifth wheel). Quiet time 11 pm; UTVs and golf carts allowed. --Claude
summary: Own site read: $30 W/E - $35 FHU confirmed (primitive $16-20, 7th night free, 2-week cancellation, $1,200/yr permanents in fees.note); water/sewer and dump added; reservable by phone. Yellow River ~23 m wide at the sites: riverfront looks like creekside (lead). Gates pass on 4.8/110 Google.
flags: WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (down, riverfront -> creekside): the Yellow River at the campground's east and south bends measures ~22-25 m wide on 0.26 m/px imagery (43.1255,-91.3148), under the ~30 m line. The outer row of pads outside the loop road sits ~15-20 m from the water across open mown grass with a fringe of tall grass, so the on-water class holds but at creek width. The stored value had no per-entry evidence (commit-level only).
PRIVATE GATES pass: Google 4.8 (110 reviews), RV Life 5 stars ($$, avg 32); price $30-35 under the US$50 gate (no gateway check needed); presence: own website with prices and phone 563-535-7347.

LONG-STAY (borderline mostly seasonal, kept): the site sells permanent spots ($1,200/year, 'Seasonal Spots Open!'), Google reviews speak of 'friendly seasonal campers' and having a permanent site, and imagery shows ~100 rigs on both sides, most with decks/sheds of long-term sites. Five tests: (1) price $30-35 pass; (2) nightly rates on its own site plus a phone, no application or approval, pass; (3) no minimum stated, pass; (4) no site count anywhere, passes by rule; (5) an RV park (five rental units only), pass. Under the 11-01 rule a borderline seasonal park drops only under 4 Google stars; 4.8/110 keeps it. A review from 6 months ago: 'Has permanent spots and overnight spots available.'
UNVERIFIED: electric 50 amp, showers, laundry and modern restrooms rest on note prose; the operator's pages state none of them (no amperage given). Left as derived.
